meta.title: Luxury Car Rental in Dubai, Delivered
meta.description: Supercars, luxury SUVs and chauffeur cars from Lamborghini, Ferrari, Rolls-Royce, Bugatti and more, delivered across Dubai including DXB and DWC. Request online, confirm on WhatsApp.

sky.title: Dubai after dark
sky.lede: Supercars, luxury SUVs and chauffeur cars, delivered to your door anywhere in Dubai. Comprehensive insurance included.
sky.noteBody: Delivery to hotels, villas and DXB or DWC arrivals. Keys handed over in person, with late handovers by arrangement.

tunnel.title: Choose your speed
tunnel.lede: Three ways to drive Dubai. Every car is delivered clean, insured and ready to drive.

supercars.title: Mid-engine coupés and spiders
supercars.body: Lamborghini, Ferrari, McLaren and Maserati, for the Jumeirah coast road and the climb up Jebel Jais.

suvs.title: Room for four or five
suvs.body: Hatta day trips, family airport runs and dinner out in Al Qudra.

chauffeur.title: Driven, by appointment
chauffeur.body: Airport transfers, city hours and evening events in a Rolls-Royce or Bentley, with a professional chauffeur.

sculpture.title: Every part on display
sculpture.lede: Keep scrolling to take the car apart, part by part. Then watch it come back together.
sculpture.schematic: The kinetic view is a schematic.

reserve.title: Ready when you land
reserve.lede: Send a request now and we bring the car to your door. {reply} Nothing is charged on this website.

fleet.title: {cars} cars, {brands} marques
fleet.lede: Every car we rent, grouped by marque. Prices are per day and include 5% VAT.

pick.title: Pick a car and dates
pick.body: Choose from {cars} cars and tell us where to bring it: your hotel, your villa or the arrivals hall at DXB or DWC.

request.title: Send a request, nothing is charged
request.body: Add your details and send the request. Nothing is charged on this website.

confirm.title: Confirm on WhatsApp
confirm.body: {reply} Once we confirm, pay at handover or by secure link.

delivery.title: Delivered across Dubai
delivery.lede: We're based in Dubai Silicon Oasis and bring the car to you, wherever you're staying.

base.title: Our office
base.body: Collect and return at Dubai Silicon Oasis at no charge.

city.title: Anywhere in Dubai
city.body: Free for rentals of {days} days or more, {fee} each way for shorter ones.

airport.title: DXB and DWC
airport.body: Meet-and-greet at arrivals, {fee} each way, airport parking included. We track your flight.

age.q: How old do I need to be?
age.a: {age} or older for most cars, with a licence held for at least {years} years ({supercarYears} years for supercars). Bugatti drivers must be {hyperAge} or older with {hyperYears} years' driving.

deposit.a: Yes. A refundable hold of {from} to {to} is placed on your card at handover, depending on the car, and shown separately from the price. We release it {days} days after the rental ends.

airport.q: Can you deliver to the airport?
airport.a: Yes. We meet you in the arrivals hall at DXB or DWC for {fee} each way, airport parking included, and we track your flight in case it's late.

included.q: What does the daily rate include?
included.a: 5% VAT, comprehensive insurance and {kmFrom} to {kmTo} km a day, depending on the car. Salik tolls are passed on at AED 4 to AED 6 per crossing, plus AED {salik} each.
